title: UNIFIED DETOXIFYING AND DEBIASING IN LANGUAGE GENERATION VIA INFERENCE-TIME ADAPTIVE OPTIMIZATION
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study. Religion is mentioned as an important category of social bias that represents an area for future work.
